audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions the brief flags as missing never reach the page: Prismatic Barrier (W) absorbing Braum's burst window, and Illumination (P) as an auto-attack-reset tell rather than a spell cast.

edits.before: - Lux Light Binding: matchup-defining — Everything keys off the root — minion-block it and the combo never starts. It writes your spacing rules. - E Unbreakable is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
